title: Top K Frequent Elements
inputFormat:
Line 1: integer n, the number of elements.
Line 2: n space-separated integers, the array nums.
Line 3: integer k.
outputFormat: k space-separated integers: the k most frequent values, ordered by descending frequency and, on ties, by ascending value.
constraints:
1 <= n <= 10^5
-10^4 <= nums[i] <= 10^4
1 <= k <= number of distinct values in nums

examples.explanation: 1 appears three times and 2 appears twice.
